sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday, looking to bounce back from a recent loss. Despite that setback, Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, and will face an Alsager side struggling near the foot of the division with just 4 points from 10 matches.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town host basement club Widnes Town on Saturday in what should be a routine fixture for the in-form home side. The title race is closely contested, with Stafford (20 pts) just two points behind leaders Sandbach. In other competitive matchups, third-placed AFC Bridgnorth visit Eccleshall in a clash between two of the division's stronger sides, while Wolverhampton Casuals—fourth with 19 points—travel to Wednesfield Community. Bilston Town, fifth with 17 points, host Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter. Elsewhere, Barnton welcome Shawbury United (Shawbury on a run of six consecutive defeats), Market Drayton Town host New Mills, Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town, Crewe face Allscott Heath, and Brereton Social host Widnes Town on Saturday before traveling to face Wednesfield Community on Wednesday evening.
